notes.title: Dev Log #16
notes.content:
Changed:

Trimmed most previous system designs. This version will not include a save feature. Each round is independent and may last for 10 minutes.

tags.feature: Each round is independent and may last for 10 minutes.

notes.content:
Added:

Minimap
Unit command: Rally

Fixed:

Fixed a bug causing conflicts when switching between shields and two-handed weapons.
Fixed a bug where projectiles got stuck too far from their target.

notes.title: Dev Log #14
notes.content:
Added:

Units can now regenerate health over time.
Fixed:

Fixed the bug where buildings did not remove from previous games.
Fixed the bug where the shield was not displaying.
Updated relics function to match the new versions.
Next:

Update the event system to work with the new gameplay systems.
Add a unit command system to control the followers.

tags.feature: Units can now regenerate health over time.

tags.bug: Fixed the bug where buildings did not remove from previous games.
Fixed the bug where the shield was not displaying.

tags.feature: Update the event system to work with the new gameplay systems.
Add a unit command system to control the followers.

notes.title: Dev Log #14
notes.content:
Added:

New resources: Iron, Stone
New building: Stonecutter Spot
Troops now have traits
Players can now gather resources

Fixed:

Fixed the bug where items wore down too quickly
Fixed the 'Man-Eater Grab Point' bug
Bosses will now spawn and drop loot upon being defeated
Fixed the bug where unit buttons did not disappear after a unit's death

tags.bug: Fixed the bug where items wore down too quickly

tags.feature: Bosses will now spawn and drop loot upon being defeated

tags.bug: Fixed the bug where unit buttons did not disappear after a unit's death
